texts.NIV84: "Be careful not to do your 'acts of righteousness' before men, to be seen by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.
texts.KJV: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
texts.NKJV: “Take heed that you do not do your charitable deeds before men, to be seen by them. Otherwise you have no reward from your Father in heaven.
texts.DRB: TAKE heed that you do not your justice before men, to be seen by them: otherwise you shall not have a reward of your Father who is in heaven.

texts.NIV84: "So when you give to the needy, do not announce it with trumpets, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by men. I tell you the truth, they have received their reward in full.
texts.KJV: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
texts.NKJV: Therefore, when you do a charitable deed, do not sound a trumpet before you as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory from men. Assuredly, I say to you, they have their reward.
texts.DRB: Therefore when thou dost an almsdeed, sound not a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may be honoured by men. Amen I say to you, they have received their reward.

texts.NIV84: But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
texts.KJV: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
texts.NKJV: But when you do a charitable deed, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
texts.DRB: But when thou dost alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doth.

texts.NIV84: so that your giving may be in secret. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
texts.KJV: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
texts.NKJV: that your charitable deed may be in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will Himself reward you openly.
texts.DRB: That thy alms may be in secret, and thy Father who seeth in secret will repay thee.
